title: 14-Inch Countertop Paper Towel Holder In Solid Brass | Antique Copper | Brass Paper Towel Holders | Allied Brass
body_html:
Keep paper towels right where you need them and reduce countertop clutter with a dedicated countertop paper towel holder that stays in place and finishes your kitchen setup in Antique Copper, which brings warm, reddish-brown tones with natural variation, perfect for rustic or craftsman-style kitchens.

  • Antique Copper creates an inviting, organic feel
  • Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your kitchen
  • Coordinated look — distinctive style from the Brass Paper Towel Holders collection
  • Clean installation details — concealed screw mounting hardware creates a finished appearance
  • Matches your fixtures — available in multiple designer finish options

Specs
Dimensions (L x H x W): 5" x 14" x 5"
Material: Solid brass
Assembly: Assembled in the USA
Warranty: Limited lifetime warranty
